cohort: The study participants were viable singleton deliveries at a single academic medical center between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2022.
finding: Multiple maternal and neonatal characteristics, including race, delivery mode, BMI, parity, pregestational diabetes, chorioamnionitis, postpartum hemorrhage, preterm birth, and neonatal resuscitation, were independently associated with completed delayed cord clamping.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were found to be less likely to have completed delayed cord clamping compared to vaginal deliveries.
